input.summary:
Surulere Chill Store chiller audit, confidence 0.80 (acceptable), planogram share 100%, no unknown products. 8 of 10 slots at expected facings; 2 stocked out: Fanta Orange 50cl PET (0/3) and Maltina 33cl Can (0/4).

Inventory check showed both SKUs at or below reorder point - Fanta 4 on hand vs RP 6, Maltina 3 on hand vs RP 6 - so back stock cannot refill the shelf and reorders were justified. Proposed: 1 case (12 units) Fanta Orange 50cl PET (~N3,600) and 2 cases (24 units) Maltina 33cl Can (~N10,800), sized to cover expected facings x 3 units plus the reorder point. Total ~N14,400.

Manager notified by WhatsApp to shelf the small remaining back stock immediately as a partial fix and to expect the delivery. No technician dispatched: no telemetry was available and no equipment fault or damage was reported - the gaps are pure stock-outs. Note for follow-up: fridge temperature is unverified at this store since cold-chain telemetry is missing.
